_comment: gis-block shape per site (showing-the-owner §1). Layer URLs are templates the operator fills in; the .invalid host marks the parcel row as shape-only. No owner-name fields, ever.

cache.rule: cache fetched features by bounding box; reuse a cached box that already contains the requested one so small GPS corrections do not refetch everything

layers.name: County parcels (shape only)
layers.source_label: Example County GIS — bring your own layer URL

privacy.rule: parcel fields MUST exclude owner names; GIS cache stays local-only, never in a public repo; blur maps in public video frames
